lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳怎麼一直看手機？在等誰的訊息嗎？
lines.simplified: 你怎么一直看手机？在等谁的讯息吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme yìzhí kàn shǒujī? Zài děng shéi de xùnxī ma?
lines.english: Why do you keep looking at your phone? Waiting for a message from someone?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 等我室友。她昨天借我的車，開到一半車就突然壞了。
lines.simplified: 等我室友。她昨天借我的车，开到一半车就突然坏了。
lines.pinyin: Děng wǒ shìyǒu. Tā zuótiān jiè wǒ de chē, kāi dào yíbàn chē jiù tūrán huài le.
lines.english: From my roommate. She borrowed my car yesterday, and halfway there it suddenly broke down.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那修車的費用誰出？
lines.simplified: 那修车的费用谁出？
lines.pinyin: Nà xiū chē de fèiyòng shéi chū?
lines.english: So who pays for the repair?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她說她會出。她在路上等了兩個小時才有人來幫忙，我本來還很同情她。
lines.simplified: 她说她会出。她在路上等了两个小时才有人来帮忙，我本来还很同情她。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō tā huì chū. Tā zài lù shàng děng le liǎng ge xiǎoshí cái yǒu rén lái bāngmáng, wǒ běnlái hái hěn tóngqíng tā.
lines.english: She says she will. She waited by the road for two hours before anyone came to help, and at first I even felt sorry for her.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那妳還在生什麼氣？
lines.simplified: 那你还在生什么气？
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ hái zài shēng shénme qì?
lines.english: Then what are you still angry about?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 她卻跟別的朋友說，車會壞都要怪我平常不好好保養，害她在路上等那麼久。
lines.simplified: 她却跟别的朋友说，车会坏都要怪我平常不好好保养，害她在路上等那么久。
lines.pinyin: Tā què gēn bié de péngyǒu shuō, chē huì huài dōu yào guài wǒ píngcháng bù hǎohǎo bǎoyǎng, hài tā zài lù shàng děng nàme jiǔ.
lines.english: Yet she told other friends that the breakdown is all my fault for never looking after the car, and that I made her wait by the road all that time.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的對室友哪一點不滿？
prompt.simplified: 女的对室友哪一点不满？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de duì shìyǒu nǎ yì diǎn bùmǎn?
prompt.english: What is the woman unhappy about with her roommate?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu jùjué fù xiū chē de qián.
choices.english: The roommate refuses to pay for the repair.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu gùyì bù huí xùnxī.
choices.english: The roommate is not answering messages on purpose.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 室友怪她沒把車保養好
choices.simplified: 室友怪她没把车保养好
choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu guài tā méi bǎ chē bǎoyǎng hǎo.
choices.english: Her roommate blames her for failing to maintain the car.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu kāichē tài bù xiǎoxīn.
choices.english: The roommate drove too carelessly.

questions.why: She had felt sorry for her roommate, but 卻 turns it round: the roommate told friends 都要怪我, putting the breakdown on her. The repair money is not the problem (她說她會出), and she is waiting for a message, not complaining about one.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽說妳弟弟騎腳踏車出了車禍，他現在情況怎麼樣？
lines.simplified: 听说你弟弟骑脚踏车出了车祸，他现在情况怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi qí jiǎotàchē chū le chēhuò, tā xiànzài qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng?
lines.english: I heard your younger brother had an accident on his bike. How is he now?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他的腳很痛，醫生要他在家休息一個月。那個開車的人連車都沒停就開走了，實在太可惡了。
lines.simplified: 他的脚很痛，医生要他在家休息一个月。那个开车的人连车都没停就开走了，实在太可恶了。
lines.pinyin: Tā de jiǎo hěn tòng, yīshēng yào tā zài jiā xiūxí yí ge yuè. Nàge kāichē de rén lián chē dōu méi tíng jiù kāi zǒu le, shízài tài kěwù le.
lines.english: His foot hurts badly, and the doctor wants him to rest at home for a month. The driver did not even stop, just drove off. Really hateful.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他下個月不是要參加籃球比賽嗎？一定很傷心吧。
lines.simplified: 他下个月不是要参加篮球比赛吗？一定很伤心吧。
lines.pinyin: Tā xià ge yuè bú shì yào cānjiā lánqiú bǐsài ma? Yídìng hěn shāngxīn ba.
lines.english: Wasn't he going to play in a basketball game next month? He must be upset.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們也這麼以為，他卻說，剛好有時間在家好好準備考試。
lines.simplified: 我们也这么以为，他却说，刚好有时间在家好好准备考试。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yě zhème yǐwéi, tā què shuō, gānghǎo yǒu shíjiān zài jiā hǎohǎo zhǔnbèi kǎoshì.
lines.english: We thought so too, but he says it gives him just the time to prepare for his exams at home.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的弟弟怎麼看受傷這件事？
prompt.simplified: 女的弟弟怎么看受伤这件事？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de dìdi zěnme kàn shòushāng zhè jiàn shì?
prompt.english: How does the woman's brother see his injury?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn shāngxīn bù néng qù bǐsài.
choices.english: He is upset he can't play in the game.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Duì kāichē de rén fēicháng bùmǎn.
choices.english: He is very unhappy with the driver.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dānxīn jiǎo huīfù de hěn màn.
choices.english: He worries his foot will heal slowly.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Juéde kěyǐ zhuānxīn dúshū le.
choices.english: He feels he can now concentrate on studying.

questions.why: 我們也這麼以為，他卻說…: 卻 sets the brother against what the family expected. Being upset about the game is what they thought, and 實在太可惡了 about the driver is the sister's own view.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我老公現在不上班了，在家照顧兩個孩子，家事也都是他負責。
lines.simplified: 我老公现在不上班了，在家照顾两个孩子，家事也都是他负责。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ lǎogōng xiànzài bú shàngbān le, zài jiā zhàogù liǎng ge háizi, jiāshì yě dōu shì tā fùzé.
lines.english: My husband doesn't go to work any more; he stays home with our two kids and does all the housework too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？那你們的家人能接受嗎？
lines.simplified: 真的吗？那你们的家人能接受吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Nà nǐmen de jiārén néng jiēshòu ma?
lines.english: Really? And can your family accept that?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我婆婆覺得男人就應該出去工作，所以有點看不起他。
lines.simplified: 我婆婆觉得男人就应该出去工作，所以有点看不起他。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ pópo juéde nánrén jiù yīnggāi chūqù gōngzuò, suǒyǐ yǒudiǎn kànbùqǐ tā.
lines.english: My mother-in-law thinks a man ought to go out to work, so she looks down on him a bit.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那他一定很在意吧。
lines.simplified: 那他一定很在意吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà tā yídìng hěn zàiyì ba.
lines.english: That must bother him, then.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他說，只要我跟孩子看得起他，別人怎麼想他都無所謂。
lines.simplified: 他说，只要我跟孩子看得起他，别人怎么想他都无所谓。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō, zhǐyào wǒ gēn háizi kàndeqǐ tā, biérén zěnme xiǎng tā dōu wúsuǒwèi.
lines.english: He says that as long as the kids and I respect him, it does not matter what anyone else thinks.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的老公是什麼態度？
prompt.simplified: 女的老公是什么态度？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de lǎogōng shì shénme tàidù?
prompt.english: What is the woman's husband's attitude?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 最重視太太跟孩子的看法
choices.simplified: 最重视太太跟孩子的看法
choices.pinyin: Zuì zhòngshì tàitai gēn háizi de kànfǎ.
choices.english: What his wife and kids think matters most to him.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Hěn zàiyì māma de kànfǎ.
choices.english: His mother's opinion bothers him a lot.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dǎsuàn zǎo yìdiǎn huíqù shàngbān.
choices.english: He plans to go back to work soon.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 也認為男人應該出去工作
choices.simplified: 也认为男人应该出去工作
choices.pinyin: Yě rènwéi nánrén yīnggāi chūqù gōngzuò.
choices.english: He too thinks a man should go out to work.

questions.why: 只要我跟孩子看得起他，別人怎麼想都沒關係: only his wife's and children's respect counts for him. Being bothered is the man's guess (一定很在意吧), and the view that a man should go out to work is his mother's (her 婆婆).

focus.en: to respect / to look down on

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 新來的經理表面上對大家很客氣，可是我覺得他看不起我們這些年輕的同事。
lines.simplified: 新来的经理表面上对大家很客气，可是我觉得他看不起我们这些年轻的同事。
lines.pinyin: Xīn lái de jīnglǐ biǎomiàn shàng duì dàjiā hěn kèqì, kěshì wǒ juéde tā kànbùqǐ wǒmen zhèxiē niánqīng de tóngshì.
lines.english: The new manager is polite to everyone on the surface, but I think he looks down on us younger staff.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 怎麼說？
lines.simplified: 怎么说？
lines.pinyin: Zěnme shuō?
lines.english: What makes you say that?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 開會的時候，我們提的意見他從來不記，老同事一說話，他就馬上寫下來。
lines.simplified: 开会的时候，我们提的意见他从来不记，老同事一说话，他就马上写下来。
lines.pinyin: Kāihuì de shíhòu, wǒmen tí de yìjiàn tā cónglái bú jì, lǎo tóngshì yì shuōhuà, tā jiù mǎshàng xiě xiàlái.
lines.english: In meetings he never notes down our ideas, but as soon as an older colleague speaks, he writes it down at once.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他才來兩個星期，可能還不熟悉大家。過一段時間再看看吧。
lines.simplified: 他才来两个星期，可能还不熟悉大家。过一段时间再看看吧。
lines.pinyin: Tā cái lái liǎng ge xīngqí, kěnéng hái bù shóuxī dàjiā. Guò yí duàn shíjiān zài kànkan ba.
lines.english: He's only been here two weeks; maybe he doesn't know everyone yet. Give it a while and see.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 經理真的看不起年輕人
choices.simplified: 经理真的看不起年轻人
choices.pinyin: Jīnglǐ zhēn de kànbùqǐ niánqīngrén.
choices.english: The manager really does look down on young people.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiànzài jiù zhème xiǎng hái tài zǎo.
choices.english: It is too early to think that now.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 老同事的意見比較可靠
choices.simplified: 老同事的意见比较可靠
choices.pinyin: Lǎo tóngshì de yìjiàn bǐjiào kěkào.
choices.english: The older colleagues' ideas are more reliable.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 男的應該跟經理當面談
choices.simplified: 男的应该跟经理当面谈
choices.pinyin: Nán de yīnggāi gēn jīnglǐ dāngmiàn tán.
choices.english: The man should talk to the manager face to face.

questions.why: She points out he has been there only two weeks and says 過一段時間再看看吧: it is too soon to decide he looks down on them. Agreeing with the man is the opposite of her point, and she never suggests talking to the manager.

focus.en: to look down on; on the surface

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳最近怎麼都不吃晚飯？
lines.simplified: 你最近怎么都不吃晚饭？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuìjìn zěnme dōu bù chī wǎnfàn?
lines.english: How come you never eat dinner lately?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下個月要拍畢業照，我想在拍照以前瘦一點。
lines.simplified: 下个月要拍毕业照，我想在拍照以前瘦一点。
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè yào pāi bìyè zhào, wǒ xiǎng zài pāizhào yǐqián shòu yìdiǎn.
lines.english: We're taking graduation photos next month, and I want to slim down a bit before then.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 為了照片好看而不吃飯，實在太不值得了。假如身體出了問題怎麼辦？
lines.simplified: 为了照片好看而不吃饭，实在太不值得了。假如身体出了问题怎么办？
lines.pinyin: Wèile zhàopiàn hǎokàn ér bù chī fàn, shízài tài bù zhídé le. Jiǎrú shēntǐ chū le wèntí zěnme bàn?
lines.english: Skipping meals to look good in a photo is not worth it. What if your health suffers?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我只不過晚上少吃一點，不會怎麼樣的。
lines.simplified: 我只不过晚上少吃一点，不会怎么样的。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ búguò wǎnshàng shǎo chī yìdiǎn, bú huì zěnmeyàng de.
lines.english: I'm only eating a bit less in the evening. Nothing will happen.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我姊姊以前也這麼說，後來常常頭痛，直到去醫院檢查，才知道是營養不夠。
lines.simplified: 我姊姊以前也这么说，后来常常头痛，直到去医院检查，才知道是营养不够。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiějie yǐqián yě zhème shuō, hòulái chángcháng tóutòng, zhídào qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá, cái zhīdào shì yíngyǎng bú gòu.
lines.english: My sister used to say that too. Then she kept getting headaches, and only when she had a checkup at the hospital did she learn she was not getting enough nutrition.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的提到他姊姊，是想告訴女的什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的提到他姊姊，是想告诉女的什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de tídào tā jiějie, shì xiǎng gàosù nǚ de shénme?
prompt.english: What does the man want to tell the woman by bringing up his sister?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 拍照以前應該先檢查身體
choices.simplified: 拍照以前应该先检查身体
choices.pinyin: Pāizhào yǐqián yīnggāi xiān jiǎnchá shēntǐ.
choices.english: She should get a checkup before the photos.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 常常頭痛要早點去檢查
choices.simplified: 常常头痛要早点去检查
choices.pinyin: Chángcháng tóutòng yào zǎo diǎn qù jiǎnchá.
choices.english: Frequent headaches call for an early checkup.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Wǎnshàng shǎo chī yìdiǎn méi guānxi.
choices.english: Eating less in the evening is fine.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 吃太少可能會影響健康
choices.simplified: 吃太少可能会影响健康
choices.pinyin: Chī tài shǎo kěnéng huì yǐngxiǎng jiànkāng.
choices.english: Eating too little can harm your health.

questions.why: His sister said the same thing, then got headaches from poor nutrition: the story warns that eating too little can hurt her health. The headaches and the hospital are part of the sister's story, not his advice, and "eating a bit less is fine" is the woman's own claim.

focus.en: for the sake of; if; not until

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 樓上的鄰居每天半夜都在唱歌，噪音大得不得了，害我一連好幾天都沒睡好。
lines.simplified: 楼上的邻居每天半夜都在唱歌，噪音大得不得了，害我一连好几天都没睡好。
lines.pinyin: Lóu shàng de línjū měi tiān bànyè dōu zài chànggē, zàoyīn dà de bùdéliǎo, hài wǒ yìlián hǎo jǐ tiān dōu méi shuì hǎo.
lines.english: My upstairs neighbour sings every night after midnight; I haven't slept well for days in a row because of it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你跟他說過了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你跟他说过了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gēn tā shuō guo le ma?
lines.english: Have you talked to him?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我一再跟他抱怨，他每次都說對不起，晚上卻還是一樣吵。
lines.simplified: 我一再跟他抱怨，他每次都说对不起，晚上却还是一样吵。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yízài gēn tā bàoyuàn, tā měi cì dōu shuō duìbùqǐ, wǎnshàng què háishì yíyàng chǎo.
lines.english: Again and again. Every time he says sorry, and every night it is just as loud.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我認識他的家人，明天就去跟他們溝通。既然答應了要幫你，我就會幫到底。
lines.simplified: 我认识他的家人，明天就去跟他们沟通。既然答应了要帮你，我就会帮到底。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ rènshì tā de jiārén, míngtiān jiù qù gēn tāmen gōutōng. Jìrán dāyìng le yào bāng nǐ, wǒ jiù huì bāng dàodǐ.
lines.english: I know his family. I'll go and talk to them tomorrow. Now that I've said I'll help, I'll see it through.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 太好了。假如這樣還是沒用，我就只好搬家了。
lines.simplified: 太好了。假如这样还是没用，我就只好搬家了。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le. Jiǎrú zhèyàng háishì méi yòng, wǒ jiù zhǐhǎo bānjiā le.
lines.english: Great. If that still doesn't work, I'll just have to move.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的現在打算怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 男的现在打算怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de xiànzài dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What does the man plan to do now?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiān děng nǚ de tán le zài shuō.
choices.english: Wait until the woman has talked to them.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Mǎshàng bān dào bié de dìfāng.
choices.english: Move somewhere else right away.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zài qù gēn línjū bàoyuàn yí cì.
choices.english: Complain to the neighbour once more.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zìjǐ qù zhǎo línjū de jiārén.
choices.english: Go to the neighbour's family himself.

questions.why: The woman will talk to the family, and he says 假如這樣還是沒用 he will move: moving only comes if her talk fails, so for now he waits. Complaining to the neighbour again is what he has already done 一再, and it is she, not he, who knows the family.

focus.en: if; again and again; to cause (something bad); see it through

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 妳找到房子了嗎？
lines.simplified: 你找到房子了吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zhǎo dào fángzi le ma?
lines.english: Have you found a place?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 有一間公寓我很滿意。房東透過網路帶我看了房間，空間很大，又很亮，離學校也很近。
lines.simplified: 有一间公寓我很满意。房东透过网路带我看了房间，空间很大，又很亮，离学校也很近。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu yì jiān gōngyù wǒ hěn mǎnyì. Fángdōng tòuguò wǎnglù dài wǒ kàn le fángjiān, kōngjiān hěn dà, yòu hěn liàng, lí xuéxiào yě hěn jìn.
lines.english: There's an apartment I really like. The landlord showed me the room over the internet: it's big and bright, and it's close to school too.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 那就趕快簽約啊！
lines.simplified: 那就赶快签约啊！
lines.pinyin: Nà jiù gǎnkuài qiānyuē a!
lines.english: Then sign the lease quickly!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他說想進一步了解我，要我這個週末去跟他當面談。我也想親眼看看房間到底長什麼樣子。
lines.simplified: 他说想进一步了解我，要我这个周末去跟他当面谈。我也想亲眼看看房间到底长什么样子。
lines.pinyin: Tā shuō xiǎng jìnyíbù liǎojiě wǒ, yào wǒ zhège zhōumò qù gēn tā dāngmiàn tán. Wǒ yě xiǎng qīnyǎn kànkan fángjiān dàodǐ zhǎng shénme yàngzi.
lines.english: He says he wants to get to know me better and wants me to go this weekend to talk with him face to face. I also want to see with my own eyes what the room really looks like.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 房租多少？
lines.simplified: 房租多少？
lines.pinyin: Fángzū duōshǎo?
lines.english: How much is the rent?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 一個月八千，押金兩個月。至於電費包不包括在裡面，他說見了面再談。
lines.simplified: 一个月八千，押金两个月。至于电费包不包括在里面，他说见了面再谈。
lines.pinyin: Yí ge yuè bāqiān, yājīn liǎng ge yuè. Zhìyú diànfèi bāo bù bāokuò zài lǐmiàn, tā shuō jiàn le miàn zài tán.
lines.english: Eight thousand a month, with two months' deposit. As for whether electricity is included, he says we will talk about it when we meet.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽妳這麼說，讓我回想起第一次租房子。那時沒問清楚電費，每個月就多付了不少錢。
lines.simplified: 听你这么说，让我回想起第一次租房子。那时没问清楚电费，每个月就多付了不少钱。
lines.pinyin: Tīng nǐ zhème shuō, ràng wǒ huíxiǎng qǐ dì yī cì zū fángzi. Nà shí méi wèn qīngchǔ diànfèi, měi ge yuè jiù duō fù le bù shǎo qián.
lines.english: Hearing that reminds me of the first time I rented a place. I didn't ask how the electricity was billed, so I paid quite a bit extra every month.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 所以我這次一定要當面問清楚，確定了再簽約。
lines.simplified: 所以我这次一定要当面问清楚，确定了再签约。
lines.pinyin: Suǒyǐ wǒ zhè cì yídìng yào dāngmiàn wèn qīngchǔ, quèdìng le zài qiānyuē.
lines.english: So this time I will ask face to face, and sign only once I am sure.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的為什麼還沒有簽約？
prompt.simplified: 女的为什么还没有签约？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de wèishénme hái méiyǒu qiānyuē?
prompt.english: Why hasn't the woman signed the lease yet?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde fángzū tài guì le.
choices.english: She thinks the rent is too high.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 有些事想見了面再確定
choices.simplified: 有些事想见了面再确定
choices.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì xiǎng jiàn le miàn zài quèdìng.
choices.english: She wants to settle some things after meeting.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 房東還沒讓她看過房間
choices.simplified: 房东还没让她看过房间
choices.pinyin: Fángdōng hái méi ràng tā kàn guo fángjiān.
choices.english: The landlord hasn't shown her the room yet.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de yào tā xiān bié jízhe qiān.
choices.english: The man told her not to rush into signing.

questions.why: The landlord wants to meet, she wants to see the room for herself, and the electricity question waits until they meet: everything left to settle needs a face-to-face visit. She has already seen the room online, the man actually said 趕快簽約啊, and nobody calls 8,000 too expensive.

focus.zh: 透過；至於；兩處合起來看
focus.en: through; as for; combining two turns

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 房東為什麼要女的這個週末去找他？
prompt.simplified: 房东为什么要女的这个周末去找他？
prompt.pinyin: Fángdōng wèishénme yào nǚ de zhège zhōumò qù zhǎo tā?
prompt.english: Why does the landlord want the woman to come and see him this weekend?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Ràng tā qīnyǎn kànkan fángjiān.
choices.english: To let her see the room with her own eyes.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Yào tā xiān fù liǎng ge yuè yājīn.
choices.english: To have her pay two months' deposit first.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Dài tā qù kàn fùjìn de xuéxiào.
choices.english: To show her the school nearby.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng duō rènshì tā zhège rén.
choices.english: He wants to know more about her as a person.

questions.why: 他說想進一步了解我: the landlord wants to know her better before renting. Seeing the room with her own eyes is the woman's reason (我也想…), and the deposit is only a number she mentions.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼提到自己第一次租房子？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么提到自己第一次租房子？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme tídào zìjǐ dì yī cì zū fángzi?
prompt.english: Why does the man bring up the first time he rented?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 要她別跟他一樣多花錢
choices.simplified: 要她别跟他一样多花钱
choices.pinyin: Yào tā bié gēn tā yíyàng duō huā qián.
choices.english: So that she does not overpay as he did.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Xiǎng shuōmíng hǎo fángzi hěn nán zhǎo.
choices.english: To explain that good places are hard to find.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Juéde bāqiān kuài tài guì le.
choices.english: He thinks eight thousand is too much.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiànyì tā zū piányí yìdiǎn de.
choices.english: He suggests she rent a cheaper one.

questions.why: He recalls that on his first rental he never asked about electricity and paid a lot more each month, and she answers that this time she will ask face to face: his story is a warning not to repeat his mistake. He never calls the rent too high or good rooms hard to find.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 昨天晚上那部戲你看了嗎？女主角終於發現她男朋友很花心了。
lines.simplified: 昨天晚上那部戏你看了吗？女主角终于发现她男朋友很花心了。
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān wǎnshàng nà bù xì nǐ kàn le ma? Nǚ zhǔjiǎo zhōngyú fāxiàn tā nánpéngyǒu hěn huāxīn le.
lines.english: Did you watch the show last night? The heroine finally found out her boyfriend is a cheat.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 看了。那個男的表面上很浪漫，天天送她玫瑰花，其實同時在跟三個女生約會。
lines.simplified: 看了。那个男的表面上很浪漫，天天送她玫瑰花，其实同时在跟三个女生约会。
lines.pinyin: Kàn le. Nàge nán de biǎomiàn shàng hěn làngmàn, tiāntiān sòng tā méiguīhuā, qíshí tóngshí zài gēn sān ge nǚshēng yuēhuì.
lines.english: I did. On the surface that guy is very romantic, giving her roses every day, but in fact he is seeing three women at the same time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我覺得女主角也有問題。她太渴望愛情了，別人說什麼她都相信，一點也不冷靜。
lines.simplified: 我觉得女主角也有问题。她太渴望爱情了，别人说什么她都相信，一点也不冷静。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ juéde nǚ zhǔjiǎo yě yǒu wèntí. Tā tài kěwàng àiqíng le, biérén shuō shénme tā dōu xiāngxìn, yìdiǎn yě bù lěngjìng.
lines.english: I think the heroine is partly to blame. She wants love so badly that she believes whatever anyone says; she is not level-headed at all.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我倒是很同情她。被自己最相信的人騙，誰都會很痛苦。
lines.simplified: 我倒是很同情她。被自己最相信的人骗，谁都会很痛苦。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dàoshì hěn tóngqíng tā. Bèi zìjǐ zuì xiāngxìn de rén piàn, shéi dōu huì hěn tòngkǔ.
lines.english: I actually feel sorry for her. Anyone would suffer, being lied to by the person they trust most.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 至於最後她會不會再跟他在一起，網友都在猜。
lines.simplified: 至于最后她会不会再跟他在一起，网友都在猜。
lines.pinyin: Zhìyú zuìhòu tā huì bú huì zài gēn tā zài yìqǐ, wǎngyǒu dōu zài cāi.
lines.english: As for whether she will end up back with him, people online are all guessing.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我猜不會。她已經不回他的訊息了。
lines.simplified: 我猜不会。她已经不回他的讯息了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ cāi bú huì. Tā yǐjīng bù huí tā de xùnxī le.
lines.english: I'd guess not. She has already stopped answering his messages.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那可不一定。下星期才演完呢！
lines.simplified: 那可不一定。下星期才演完呢！
lines.pinyin: Nà kě bù yídìng. Xià xīngqí cái yǎn wán ne!
lines.english: Don't be so sure. It doesn't end until next week!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 從對話來看，女主角發現了男朋友的什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 从对话来看，女主角发现了男朋友的什么事？
prompt.pinyin: Cóng duìhuà lái kàn, nǚzhǔjiǎo fāxiàn le nán péngyǒu de shénme shì?
prompt.english: From the conversation, what did the heroine find out about her boyfriend?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā tài kěwàng àiqíng le.
choices.english: He longs for love too much.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā hěn tóngqíng bié de nǚshēng.
choices.english: He feels sorry for other women.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā hái gēn bié de nǚshēng yuēhuì.
choices.english: He was also dating other women.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他已經不回她的訊息了
choices.simplified: 他已经不回她的讯息了
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐjīng bù huí tā de xùnxī le.
choices.english: He no longer answers her messages.

questions.why: He brought her roses every day, but he was dating three women at the same time. The woman says the heroine longs for love, and it is the heroine who stopped answering his messages.

focus.en: unfaithful; on the surface ... in fact

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的說「我倒是很同情她」，是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的说「我倒是很同情她」，是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shuō "wǒ dàoshì hěn tóngqíng tā", shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean when he says "I actually feel sorry for her"?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他也覺得女主角不夠冷靜
choices.simplified: 他也觉得女主角不够冷静
choices.pinyin: Tā yě juéde nǚzhǔjiǎo bú gòu lěngjìng.
choices.english: He too thinks the heroine is not calm enough.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde wǎngyǒu dōu cāi cuò le.
choices.english: He thinks the netizens all guessed wrong.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他同情的是那個男朋友
choices.simplified: 他同情的是那个男朋友
choices.pinyin: Tā tóngqíng de shì nàge nán péngyǒu.
choices.english: It is the boyfriend he feels sorry for.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他不像女的那樣怪女主角
choices.simplified: 他不像女的那样怪女主角
choices.pinyin: Tā bú xiàng nǚ de nàyàng guài nǚzhǔjiǎo.
choices.english: He doesn't blame the heroine as the woman does.

questions.why: The woman has just said the heroine is partly to blame (太渴望愛情, 不冷靜); 倒是 sets his view against hers: being deceived by someone you trust hurts anyone, so he does not blame her. Not calm enough is the woman's view, and the netizens come up only later, about the ending.

focus.en: on the other hand; to feel sorry for

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的最後一句話是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 女的最后一句话是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de zuìhòu yí jù huà shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the woman's last line mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 女主角最後會回去找他
choices.simplified: 女主角最后会回去找他
choices.pinyin: Nǚ zhǔjiǎo zuìhòu huì huíqù zhǎo tā.
choices.english: The heroine will go back to him in the end.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Jiéguǒ xiànzài hái hěn nán shuō.
choices.english: The outcome is still hard to tell.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nán de cāi de hěn duì.
choices.english: The man has guessed right.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Zhè bù xì xià xīngqí bù yǎn le.
choices.english: The show will not be on next week.

questions.why: 那可不一定 doubts the man's guess without making her own: the ending (至於……網友都在猜) is still open because the show runs until next week. She does not say the heroine will go back, and 下星期才演完 means it is still on next week.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段廣播，然後回答三個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段广播，然后回答三个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn guǎngbò, ránhòu huídá sān ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a broadcast, then answer three questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 聽眾朋友早安。警察說，今年開車出車禍的人裡，差不多一半是二十五歲以下的年輕人。
lines.simplified: 听众朋友早安。警察说，今年开车出车祸的人里，差不多一半是二十五岁以下的年轻人。
lines.pinyin: Tīngzhòng péngyǒu zǎo'ān. Jǐngchá shuō, jīnnián kāichē chū chēhuò de rén lǐ, chàbùduō yíbàn shì èrshíwǔ suì yǐxià de niánqīngrén.
lines.english: Good morning, listeners. The police say that this year almost half of the drivers in car accidents were young people aged twenty-five or under.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 很多年輕人對自己開車很有信心，覺得一邊開車一邊看手機也不會有事。
lines.simplified: 很多年轻人对自己开车很有信心，觉得一边开车一边看手机也不会有事。
lines.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīngrén duì zìjǐ kāichē hěn yǒu xìnxīn, juéde yìbiān kāichē yìbiān kàn shǒujī yě bú huì yǒu shì.
lines.english: Many young people are confident in their driving, and that looking at their phone while driving will do no harm.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 車禍卻常常就發生在看手機的那一兩秒之間。
lines.simplified: 车祸却常常就发生在看手机的那一两秒之间。
lines.pinyin: Chēhuò què chángcháng jiù fāshēng zài kàn shǒujī de nà yì liǎng miǎo zhījiān.
lines.english: Yet accidents often happen in the one or two seconds spent looking at the phone.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 警察透過社群網站貼了影片。年輕人談起自己出車禍的經過，提醒大家開車別看手機。
lines.simplified: 警察透过社群网站贴了影片。年轻人谈起自己出车祸的经过，提醒大家开车别看手机。
lines.pinyin: Jǐngchá tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn tiē le yǐngpiàn. Niánqīngrén tán qǐ zìjǐ chū chēhuò de jīngguò, tíxǐng dàjiā kāichē bié kàn shǒujī.
lines.english: The police posted videos on social media. Young people talked about how their crashes happened to remind everyone to stay off their phones while driving.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 影片裡一位女生說，她自己不怕痛，最讓她難過的是爸媽每天都得跑醫院照顧她，她覺得很對不起他們。
lines.simplified: 影片里一位女生说，她自己不怕痛，最让她难过的是爸妈每天都得跑医院照顾她，她觉得很对不起他们。
lines.pinyin: Yǐngpiàn lǐ yí wèi nǚshēng shuō, tā zìjǐ bú pà tòng, zuì ràng tā nánguò de shì bàmā měi tiān dōu děi pǎo yīyuàn zhàogù tā, tā juéde hěn duìbùqǐ tāmen.
lines.english: In one video a young woman says she isn't afraid of the pain herself; what upsets her most is that her parents have to rush to the hospital every day to look after her, and she feels she has let them down.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 開車的時候請把手機收好，這樣才對得起自己，也對得起關心你的人。
lines.simplified: 开车的时候请把手机收好，这样才对得起自己，也对得起关心你的人。
lines.pinyin: Kāichē de shíhòu qǐng bǎ shǒujī shōu hǎo, zhèyàng cái duìdeqǐ zìjǐ, yě duìdeqǐ guānxīn nǐ de rén.
lines.english: When you drive, please put your phone away. That is how you do right by yourself and by the people who care about you.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 警察為什麼貼這些影片？
prompt.simplified: 警察为什么贴这些影片？
prompt.pinyin: Jǐngchá wèishénme tiē zhèxiē yǐngpiàn?
prompt.english: Why did the police post these videos?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 提醒父母多管開車的孩子
choices.simplified: 提醒父母多管开车的孩子
choices.pinyin: Tíxǐng fùmǔ duō guǎn kāichē de háizi.
choices.english: To remind parents to keep an eye on their driving children.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 教大家車禍後怎麼照顧家人
choices.simplified: 教大家车祸后怎么照顾家人
choices.pinyin: Jiāo dàjiā chēhuò hòu zěnme zhàogù jiārén.
choices.english: To teach people how to care for family after an accident.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 讓大家知道開車看手機很危險
choices.simplified: 让大家知道开车看手机很危险
choices.pinyin: Ràng dàjiā zhīdào kāichē kàn shǒujī hěn wéixiǎn.
choices.english: To show everyone how dangerous it is to look at a phone while driving.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 說明年輕人開車開得不好
choices.simplified: 说明年轻人开车开得不好
choices.pinyin: Shuōmíng niánqīngrén kāichē kāi de bù hǎo.
choices.english: To show that young people drive badly.

questions.why: The crash stories warn everyone about looking at a phone while driving. One story mentions the driver's parents to show how a crash can affect a family.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 影片裡的女生為什麼覺得對不起父母？

passage.traditional: 我的室友單身三年了，一直很{1}有一段浪漫的愛情。上個月，她透過社群網站認識了一個男生。對方每天傳訊息{2}她，還為她寫了一首歌。她覺得他是真的{3}她，才聊了兩個星期，就說自己找到了理想的對象。我提醒她，他在網路上說的話不一定是真的，她卻覺得我想太多。{4}有一天，她在對方上傳的影片裡，聽到他叫旁邊的女人「老婆」，才發現他一直在{5}自己是單身。原來他早就結婚了，卻還同時跟好幾個女生約會，是一個很{6}的人。

Duìfāng měi tiān chuán xùnxī wènhòu tā, hái wèi tā xiě le yì shǒu gē. Tā juéde tā shì zhēn de xīnshǎng tā, cái liáo le liǎng ge xīngqí, jiù shuō zìjǐ zhǎo dào le lǐxiǎng de duìxiàng. Wǒ tíxǐng tā, tā zài wǎnglù shàng shuō de huà bù yídìng shì zhēn de, tā què juéde wǒ xiǎng tài duō. Zhídào yǒu yì tiān, tā zài duìfāng shàngchuán de yǐngpiàn lǐ, tīng dào tā jiào pángbiān de nǚrén "lǎopó", cái fāxiàn tā yìzhí zài jiǎzhuāng zìjǐ shì dānshēn. Yuánlái tā zǎo jiù jiéhūn le, què hái tóngshí gēn hǎo jǐ ge nǚshēng yuēhuì, shì yí ge hěn huāxīn de rén.
passage.english: My roommate has been single for three years and has always longed for a romantic love. Last month she met a man through social media. He sent her messages every day asking how she was, and wrote a song for her. She felt he really admired her, and after chatting for only two weeks she said she had found her ideal partner. I reminded her that what he said online might not be true, but she thought I was worrying too much. Then one day, in a video he had posted, she heard him call the woman beside him "wife", and only then did she find out he had been pretending all along to be single. In fact he had long been married, yet he was dating several women at the same time: he was a real flirt.

Qùnián wǒ jiāo tā yòng shǒujī, hái jiāo tā shàng shèqún wǎngzhàn. Jiārén běnlái dōu yǐwéi tā bú huì yǒu xìngqù. Méi xiǎngdào, bú dào yí ge yuè, tā jiù zài shàngmiàn zhǎo dào le liùshí nián qián de lǎo tóngxué. Liǎng ge rén měi tiān chuán xùnxī, yìqǐ huíxiǎng niánqīng shíhòu de shì, zǔfù de huà yě yuè lái yuè duō le. Shàng ge yuè, tāmen zài nánbù jiàn le miàn, yì liáo jiù shì yì zhěng ge xiàwǔ, bìjìng yǐjīng liùshí nián méi jiàn le. Zǔfù huílái yǐhòu gēn wǒ shuō, wǎnglù suīrán fāngbiàn, kěshì chuán zài duō xùnxī, yě qǔdài bù liǎo dāngmiàn liáotiān de gǎnjué.
passage.english: My grandfather is eighty this year. Ever since my grandmother died he has hardly gone out, and his manner towards the family has become very distant. Last year I taught him to use a phone and showed him how to go on social media. The family all thought he would not be interested. To our surprise, in less than a month he found a classmate from sixty years ago there. The two of them message each other every day, looking back together on when they were young, and Grandpa talks more and more. Last month they met in the south and talked for a whole afternoon; after all, they had not seen each other for sixty years. When Grandpa came back he told me that although the internet is convenient, no number of messages can replace the feeling of talking face to face.

text.traditional:
自從有了社群網站，現代人交友的範圍擴大了很多。科技的進步讓人人都能隨時隨地跟世界各地的人聊天。不過，也有不少人認為，網路上的友誼只是表面的，取代不了真實生活中的朋友。
我本來也這麼想，直到我認識了小安。我們是在一個讀書社團認識的，剛開始只是聊書，後來也會互相說心事。我遇到煩惱的時候，她都會主動傳訊息來問候我。去年我生病住院，她特地從花蓮坐了三個小時的火車來看我。那是我們第一次見面，我卻一點也不覺得陌生，反而覺得很熟悉。
這件事讓我發覺，網路只是人與人之間接觸的一種方式。友誼是真是假，跟在哪裡認識無關，要看兩個人是不是誠實。當然，網路上也有一些不老實的人，例如故意用假名字、假照片的騙子，所以跟網友見面以前，還是要小心。可是，如果因為怕上當，就拒絕跟所有的網友建立關係，也可能會失去一個真正的朋友。

这件事让我发觉，网路只是人与人之间接触的一种方式。友谊是真是假，跟在哪里认识无关，要看两个人是不是诚实。当然，网路上也有一些不老实的人，例如故意用假名字、假照片的骗子，所以跟网友见面以前，还是要小心。可是，如果因为怕上当，就拒绝跟所有的网友建立关系，也可能会失去一个真正的朋友。

Zhè jiàn shì ràng wǒ fājué, wǎnglù zhǐ shì rén yǔ rén zhījiān jiēchù de yì zhǒng fāngshì. Yǒuyí shì zhēn shì jiǎ, gēn zài nǎlǐ rènshì wúguān, yào kàn liǎng ge rén shì bú shì chéngshí. Kěshì, rúguǒ yīnwèi pà shàngdàng, jiù jùjué gēn suǒyǒu de wǎngyǒu jiànlì guānxì, yě kěnéng huì shīqù yí ge zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu.
text.english:
Ever since social media appeared, the circle in which people today make friends has grown a great deal. Progress in technology lets everyone chat with people all over the world, anytime and anywhere. But many people also believe that friendship online is only on the surface and cannot replace friends in real life.
I used to think so too, until I got to know Xiao An. We met in a reading group. At first we only talked about books, but later we also told each other what was on our minds. Whenever something was troubling me, she would always be the one to send a message asking how I was. Last year I fell ill and was in hospital, and she came specially from Hualien, three hours by train, to see me. That was the first time we had met, yet she did not feel like a stranger at all; she felt familiar.
This made me realise that the internet is just one way for people to come into contact with each other. Whether a friendship is real or false has nothing to do with where you met; it depends on whether the two people are honest. Of course, there are some dishonest people online, such as cheats who use false names and photos on purpose, so you still need to be careful before meeting an online friend. But if, for fear of being tricked, you refuse to build a relationship with any online friend, you may lose a real friend.

text.traditional:
我和老婆是十年前透過網路認識的，那時她才十九歲。家人和大部分朋友聽說我在網路上認識她，都要我別太快相信對方，因為新聞常說有人交網友上當。她的父母從來沒接觸過網路交友，更是擔心，覺得她年紀還小、不懂事，怎麼能每天跟陌生人聊到半夜。
不過，我們從一開始就約好，要對對方完全誠實。她第一次傳照片給我，就老實地告訴我，那張照片是兩年前照的，跟她本人不太一樣。我也沒有故意把自己說得多好，連考試不及格的事都告訴了她。聊了半年，我們之間的友誼慢慢變成了愛情，這時候才決定見面。見面那天，她爸爸也來了。他一開始對我很冷淡，問了很多問題，我都誠實地回答了。後來他說，就是因為我沒有假裝自己很成功，他才放心讓女兒跟我交往。
現在我們結婚八年了，兩個網友成了一家人。常有人問我，在網路上找老公或老婆，難道不怕被騙嗎？我覺得，騙子哪裡都有，不能只怪網路。不管在哪裡認識，兩個人能不能走下去，要看一開始是不是對對方誠實。
text.simplified:
我和老婆是十年前透过网路认识的，那时她才十九岁。家人和大部分朋友听说我在网路上认识她，都要我别太快相信对方，因为新闻常说有人交网友上当。她的父母从来没接触过网路交友，更是担心，觉得她年纪还小、不懂事，怎么能每天跟陌生人聊到半夜。
不过，我们从一开始就约好，要对对方完全诚实。她第一次传照片给我，就老实地告诉我，那张照片是两年前照的，跟她本人不太一样。我也没有故意把自己说得多好，连考试不及格的事都告诉了她。聊了半年，我们之间的友谊慢慢变成了爱情，这时候才决定见面。见面那天，她爸爸也来了。他一开始对我很冷淡，问了很多问题，我都诚实地回答了。后来他说，就是因为我没有假装自己很成功，他才放心让女儿跟我交往。
现在我们结婚八年了，两个网友成了一家人。常有人问我，在网路上找老公或老婆，难道不怕被骗吗？我觉得，骗子哪里都有，不能只怪网路。不管在哪里认识，两个人能不能走下去，要看一开始是不是对对方诚实。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hé lǎopó shì shí nián qián tòuguò wǎnglù rènshì de, nà shí tā cái shíjiǔ suì. Jiārén hé dà bùfèn péngyǒu tīngshuō wǒ zài wǎnglù shàng rènshì tā, dōu yào wǒ bié tài kuài xiāngxìn duìfāng, yīnwèi xīnwén cháng shuō yǒu rén jiāo wǎngyǒu shàngdàng. Tā de fùmǔ cónglái méi jiēchù guo wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, gèng shì dānxīn, juéde tā niánjì hái xiǎo, bù dǒngshì, zěnme néng měi tiān gēn mòshēng rén liáo dào bànyè. Búguò, wǒmen cóng yì kāishǐ jiù yuē hǎo, yào duì duìfāng wánquán chéngshí. Tā dì yī cì chuán zhàopiàn gěi wǒ, jiù lǎoshí de gàosu wǒ, nà zhāng zhàopiàn shì liǎng nián qián zhào de, gēn tā běnrén bú tài yíyàng. Wǒ yě méiyǒu gùyì bǎ zìjǐ shuō de duō hǎo, lián kǎoshì bù jígé de shì dōu gàosu le tā. Liáo le bàn nián, wǒmen zhījiān de yǒuyí mànmàn biàn chéng le àiqíng, zhè shíhòu cái juédìng jiànmiàn. Jiànmiàn nà tiān, tā bàba yě lái le. Tā yì kāishǐ duì wǒ hěn lěngdàn, wèn le hěn duō wèntí, wǒ dōu chéngshí de huídá le. Hòulái tā shuō, jiù shì yīnwèi wǒ méiyǒu jiǎzhuāng zìjǐ hěn chénggōng, tā cái fàngxīn ràng nǚ'ér gēn wǒ jiāowǎng. Xiànzài wǒmen jiéhūn bā nián le, liǎng ge wǎngyǒu chéng le yì jiā rén. Cháng yǒu rén wèn wǒ, zài wǎnglù shàng zhǎo lǎogōng huò lǎopó, nándào bú pà bèi piàn ma? Wǒ juéde, piànzi nǎlǐ dōu yǒu, bù néng zhǐ guài wǎnglù. Bùguǎn zài nǎlǐ rènshì, liǎng ge rén néng bù néng zǒu xiàqù, yào kàn yì kāishǐ shì bú shì duì duìfāng chéngshí.
text.english:
My wife and I met online ten years ago, when she was only nineteen. When my family and most of my friends heard I had met her online, they all told me not to trust her too quickly, because the news often told of people tricked by online friends. Her parents, who had never come across making friends online, were even more worried; they thought she was still young and naive: how could she chat with a stranger until midnight every day?
But from the very start we agreed to be completely honest with each other. The first time she sent me a photo, she told me frankly that it had been taken two years earlier and did not look quite like her now. I did not make myself sound better on purpose either; I even told her about failing an exam. After half a year of chatting, the friendship between us slowly turned into love, and only then did we decide to meet. Her father came too that day. At first he was cold towards me and asked a lot of questions, and I answered all of them honestly. Later he said that it was precisely because I did not pretend to be very successful that he felt at ease letting his daughter go out with me.
Now we have been married for eight years, and two online friends have become a family. People often ask me whether I wasn't afraid of being cheated, looking for a husband or wife online. I think there are cheats everywhere, and you cannot just blame the internet. Wherever two people meet, whether they can go the distance depends on whether they are honest with each other from the start.

His view comes at the end, not first; the news is only what worried his family; no two ways are compared; and the story shows the worries were unfounded.
